# Mac app — Delegation and threads

## Delegation and reports

![Delegation and reports](data:image/webp;base64,)

### DelegationViews.swift
- DelegationCard surface r24 pad 14/14/12: header 13.5 (CrewGlyph conductor 16, 'Delegated 3 tasks' / 'Team of 3' medium, task ids 11.5 mono fg4, or lead link fg3 + StatusPill 'Combining'); pad h4
- rail: list pt4 pl8 with 1.5px line at leading; gap 8
- RailRow connector: path from x -8.75 down 20 curving to (5,34) to (16,34), stroke 1.5 in status color: done fg, running/queued live, needs needs, else lineStrong; row pl16
- BranchFace: bg r20 cardShadow pad 14x12: CrewGlyph 15 fg2 in 32 surface circle; title 14 medium; meta 12 fg3 gap 8 (role, #channel, HarnessMark, task id mono fg2, detail fg4 e.g. 'started 2m ago' / 'report in · 5m ago' / 'waiting for a slot'); StatusPill right
- AgentRow (sub-agent): BranchFace meta: type, 'background', '12 tools', Chevron; opens ToolDetail + children
- CrewGlyph: conductor ring stroke 3.6 r7; researcher ring 17 stroke 1.75 + dot 6.4; builder rounded square 16 r3.5 + filled 8 square offset; else layers

### ModViews.swift
- ModLog: plugin 11 mono fg3 + text 12 fg4, gap 2
- ModStatusLines: plugin 10.5 mono fg4 + text 11.5 fg3
- ModStatusChip: 11 fg3 pad h6 surface2 capsule (max 40 chars)
- ModToastStack (top right of thread): bell 14 fg3; text 13 medium fg (3 lines) + plugin 11 mono fg4; pad 14x10 max320 bg r14 line stroke menuShadow; gap 8 pad 16

### LimitCard.swift / SetupCard.swift
- surface, r16, line stroke, pt8; pad 16x12; lead 28 circle: scheduled surface2 + clock fg2 / else needs@.12 + gauge needs; title 14 semibold; body 12.5 fg3; actions pills 28 (first primary, rest secondary) with icon 13
- Setup: 'Preparing worktree' (Loader 14 in surface2) 'Making the thread its own checkout before anything runs.' / 'Setup failed' (alert needs on needs@.12) 'Nothing ran. Your message and files are kept and send once the worktree is ready.' + reason 11.5 mono fg2 on surface2 r8 pad 10x6 + branch IconLabel 11.5 mono fg4 + primary 'Retry' (refresh)

### PublishedViews.swift
- PublishedCard surface r22 pad 16x12 gap 10: globe 15 fg3 in 32 bg circle; title 13.5 medium + 'Published on claude.ai' / 'Republished…' 11.5 fg4; description 12.5 fg3 2 lines; actions pl44 gap6: primary 'Open' (external 13), secondary 'Preview' (layers), ghost 'Check comments' (message) → 'Asked, runs after this turn' (check)

## Header and context

![Header and context](data:image/webp;base64,)

### ContextMeterView.swift
- ContextMeterButton: ring 18 + '42%' 11.5 (level color), pad h6 h28; popover
- ContextRing: track lineStrong width size*2.5/18 (dashed [2,2.5] if unknown); fill fg3 ok / warn / needs critical; min 2%
- ContextPanel w380 elev: headline ring 40, '42%' 20, 'of the context window' 12 fg3, '84.2k of 200k tokens' 12 fg3, model 11.5 fg4, refresh icon button 28
- 'Autocompact starts at 160k (80%). The model allows 1M.' 11.5 fg3
- PanelSection: UPPERCASE 10.5 medium tracking .6 fg3 + note 'approximate' 10.5 fg4 (NB: this one IS caps)
- TokenBar: label 12 fg2 + tokens fg3; 3px wash track, fill fg3 (faint lineStrong)
- Largest tool results rows: tool fg2, path 11 mono fg4, tokens fg3
- footer: source note 11 fg4 'Updated 2m ago.'
- CompactAction: 'Summarize the conversation to free up room.' 11.5 fg4 + secondary pill 28 (layers 13) 'Compact'; asking: text 12.5 fg2 + optional field + ghost Cancel / primary 'Compact now' pills 28; compacting: running glyph + 'Compacting. The meter refreshes when it finishes.'

### ThreadScreen.swift
- states: notFound EmptyNote(message,'Thread not found','It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.' + secondary 'Go home'); failed ErrorNote+Retry; loading Loader 14 + 'Loading thread' 13 fg3 centered
- layout: ThreadHeader / Transcript (ModToastStack top-right) / ReplyComposer; inspector side panel (.threadInspector)
- ThreadHeader pad h24 top12 bottom8 gap12: ChannelAvatar 34; crumb 12 fg3: '#Volero' > chevronRight 10 fg4 > parent title, task id 10.5 fg4 (NOT mono here, monospacedDigit); title 17 medium; ModStatusLines; right: Reconnecting (running glyph 6 + 11 fg3), ContextMeterButton, archived → secondary 28 'Restore' (archive 14), StatusPill
- ChannelAvatar 34: surface2 disc + letter 0.42 rounded medium fg2; conductor: fg disc + StaticMark .55 onInk; icon glyph .5
- ErrorNote: needs glyph 8 + 13 fg, pad 16x10 surface r16, optional secondary 'Retry' 26
- Transcript: maxW 896 pad h24 top16 bottom40; rows gap 16
- NewActivityPill: chevronDown 13 + 'New activity' 12 medium fg pad h14 h32 elev capsule menuShadow; bottom 16
- order: messages / tools(group + subagent DelegationCard + DelegationCards + PublishedCards) / plan / result / error / report / mod log; then WorkingLine, SetupCard, LimitCard, Queued, Parked, StaleEdits, NextThreadCard
